targets.model: No conozco esa palabra, pero entiendo la idea.
targets.confusion: Permit unresolved details while checking essential meaning.

units.revision: Reward responsive reasoning in Spanish, not agreeing with an assessor. Avoid unfamiliar domain knowledge deciding the score.
units.held_out_scenario: Defend a practical proposal, fairly restate a counterargument and revise after new information.

targets.model: Mi propuesta es cambiar la hora por dos razones.
targets.confusion: Structure should serve substance, not formulaic recital.

targets.model: Es cierto que cuesta más, pero dura más.
targets.confusion: Represent the other person's point accurately.
Tone changes whether a question sounds curious or confrontational.

targets.model: Tienes razón en eso; cambiaría mi propuesta.
targets.confusion: Revision is communicative success, not loss of points.

units.revision: C3 sound reduction is receptive only. Use several speakers per region; no accent or country is a single uniform profile.
units.held_out_scenario: Understand two reviewed regional versions and choose a consistent address/register lane in a new exchange.

targets.variants: Ustedes pueden; vos sos; vos tenés
targets.confusion: Voseo is not limited to Argentina; usage varies locally.
Do not claim every regional word is universal or restricted to one country.

targets.model: Identify known words in naturally reduced speech.
targets.variants: S aspiration or deletion in labeled clips; yeísmo variants
targets.confusion: Recognition target only; do not caricature speakers or demand imitation.

targets.variants: Written message versus casual voice note
targets.confusion: Choose by relationship and situation, not a universal formal country stereotype.

units.revision: C4 continuing plan is reflective, not a graded language gate. Fifteen minutes and all eight stages do not confer B2 or native-like fluency.
units.held_out_scenario: Negotiate changing constraints, explain a short notice and repair a missing word with an unfamiliar interlocutor.

targets.model: Negotiate a plan with changing constraints.
targets.variants: Ask, clarify, respond, revise and close
targets.confusion: A rehearsed script does not establish spontaneous ability.

targets.model: Explain a short notice to another person in simple Spanish.
targets.variants: Summarize a plan; clarify an instruction
targets.confusion: Do not require professional translation or medical interpretation.

targets.model: Rephrase a missing word and keep going.
targets.variants: Describe it; ask what it is called
targets.confusion: Reward effective repair without pretending the missing vocabulary is known.

targets.model: Identify a topic and listening gap to work on next.
targets.confusion: Completion opens maintenance and growth; it does not imply native-like fluency.
